sources.title: Wait, What? GTA 6 Runs Better On Xbox Series X Than PS5
sources.text: Digital Foundry Grand Theft Auto VI GTA 6 Rockstar When it comes toÂ GTA 6 , PlayStation has very much been the teacher’s pet. Microsoft was operating under a weird-ass ban that prevented it from marketing the fact that the game was coming out on its console, while the PS5 has been broadly promoted as the natural home for Rockstar’s record-breaking release. And yet, Digital Foundry ‘s latest analysis ofÂ GTA 6 ‘s performance across all four of Microsoft and Sony’s current-gen systems shows the Series X outdoing the PS5. “Ultimately,” the site’s boffins report, “Series X is meaningfully better off.” It’s important to mention right away that the PS5 Pro still wipes the floor with the Series X, and is without doubt the best way to play Grand Theft Auto VI until the official PC version is released. But when you measure the two base machines between the rival console makers,Â DF says there’s no doubt that it’s the Series X that edges ahead of the PS5. Both consoles offer “a virtually identical visual presentation,” say the tech experts, with nothing to divide them in all the important areas. But when it comes to performance, this is where Xbox takes the lead. Both machines struggle during “heavy vehicle traversal” and “intense airport crowd sequences,” but the PS5 “suffers substantially more frequent frame-rate drops” than the Series X, “which is compounded by the fact that the Xbox machine also benefits from 120Hz VRR support to smooth out minor dips.” Unsurprisingly, the Series S performs the poorest out of all four, but actually offers better results than anyone was expecting. While its framerate drops are horrible, frequently dipping into the teens, the use of PSR 4.1 upscaling and a reduction in the most intensive details still has it looking pretty lovely. It’s definitely not a great way to play the game, but it’s less terrible than you’d think. So there you go, Xbox owners: you’re not the ugly stepsister you might have been made to feel like. Obviously the differences remain slight, and with both consoles (and even the PS5 Pro) capped to 30 FPS there are compromises to be made by all, so whether you’re playing on PlayStation or Xbox Series X, you’re mostly having the same experience. But Xbox owners have earned themselves a quietly smug grin. Donât miss the latest reviews, news and tips. Sign up for our free newsletter. sources.title: GTA 6 reinvigorates PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series S/X console sales in the US, even at their inflated prices
sources.text: Despite the far higher prices of PlayStation and Xbox consoles today compared to their launch, or even the same period last year, both brands of console saw a significant boost in US sales leading up to the launch of this generation's biggest game: Grand Theft Auto 6. In the week ending 14th November, PS5 hardware unit sales registered a 2.4x increase over the same week last year. Xbox wasn't far behind, seeing a 2.3x increase in its own unit sales. That's according to industry analyst Mat Piscatella at Circana , who pulled the data from Circana's retail tracking service, which covers the US retail market. The PS5 Pro only accounted for less than 10 percent of the PlayStation's total unit sales, by the way, which Piscatella noted was "a LOT better than it has been in recent weeks", and seemingly the result of increased supply. GTA 6, of course, released on 19th November, so the surge in console hardware sales was clearly driven by the rush to attain consoles before the game came out. And while the GTA 6-driven demand isn't surprising, it's worth noting how much more expensive PS5 and Xbox Series X/S consoles are today. A standard PS5 today costs $650, compared to $550 a year ago. The PS5 Pro saw a big jump from $750 last November to $900 today. The base Xbox Series X jumped from $650 last year to $800 today, while Series S now costs $500, up from $400. Even Switch 2, where GTA 6 is not available, saw a notable boost of 40 percent in hardware sales over the same period, driven by The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake and the special edition Zelda Switch 2 console . Circana's November US video game market report, which releases in December, is already one of the most anticipated this year, for digesting and documenting the GTA 6 effect. Worldwide, GTA 6 sold more than 32.5m copies in one day , making Rockstar's parent company Take-Two $3.79bn (£2.89bn) in revenue. We haven't had any updated official sales figures since; but estimates suggest the sales figure could be well into the 40-millions. Perhaps Rockstar is waiting to hit the nice round 50m sales mark before announcing it. If you're playing GTA 6, you may want to keep Eurogamer's GTA 6 walkthrough to hand. It has plenty of very helpful guides covering the game's main missions, as well as explainers for mechanics like romance and the criminal profile , and even cheats for when you finish the game.

sources.title: Lords of the Fallen 2 delayed to April 2027, release date coming next month
sources.text: The sequel was only announced last summer It's happening. We have some more movement on Lords of the Fallen 2 from CI Games. No, there still isn't a release date, but we know when we're getting one. The action RPG sequel is now due to arrive slightly later than previously announced, but still in the first half of 2027, and we'll be hearing more quite soon. Marek Tyminski, the CEO of CI Games, reveals the details himself. "Lords of the Fallen 2: April 2027," he writes on Twitter . "Exact date in December." What Tyminski's post doesn't specify this that this is actually another delay. The game was originally due in the back half of this year, before moving to the first quarter of 2027 . While it's slightly annoying to only get an announcement for the announcement, at least we know we don't have long to wait to find out when exactly Lords of the Fallen 2 is coming out. Knowing the release month is very helpful too. I could be wrong here, of course, but that seems to all but guarantee the game's presence at The Game Awards. Trailers and reveals are always a big part of the show, and I'm not sure where else we might see the follow-up otherwise, unless CI Games is planning some sort of livestream of its own we're not yet aware of. Regardless of the delay, this is all pretty quick turnaround for the release, since Lords of the Fallen 2 was only announced during the Opening Night Live of Gamescom 2025. Maybe I'm just jaded from increasingly elongated announcement schedules for blockbuster games, but getting the release window only a year and a half after the formal reveal is pretty tight by today's standards. I mean, we just waited years to find out what the full title of The Elder Scrolls 6 is. We'll see what CI Games has to offer come December, which, at time of writing, is just six days away. Maybe Mariah Carey will be involved in some way. I doubt it, but imagine. I bet she loves a bit of Lords of the Fallen, honestly. "Blizzard, I'm looking at you" - Path of Exile 2 boss calls out AAA studios' lackluster game announcements, implores devs to stop trying to have a "'one more thing' moment." sources.title: How to Play Grand Theft Auto VI in the Cloud and with Remote Play
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto VI supports XBOX Cloud Gaming , making it available to play even without a current-gen console. With XBOX Cloud Gaming, you can play by streaming it straight from the cloud to your XBOX One, or XBOX Series X|S if you’d like to save some hard drive space. Select Game Pass plans include a monthly allotment of up to 15 play hours, and you can buy more cloud playtime if you need it, giving you the opportunity to experience one of the biggest games of the year on the consoles you already own. The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming. You can also access Remote Play to enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI wherever you want to play , allowing you to stream gameplay directly from your XBOX Series X|S console to devices you already own, like your mobile phone, laptops, PCs, or even a handheld gaming PC like the XBOX ROG Ally. FYI, even wireless networks with high bandwidth can occasionally have a dip in audio and video quality. Remote Play allows you to stream gameplay from your XBOX Series X|S to devices you already own, like mobile devices, PCs, and handheld gaming PCs. sources.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Is Out, and There Are Already Black Friday GTA 6 Deals
sources.text: Rockstar's GTA 6 has barely been out for a few days, but UK retailer ShopTo is already offering some surprisingly generous discounts on the new release across PS5 and Xbox Series X|S — letting you pay as little as £53.85 for the game. Here's how to save on what's arguably the biggest game of all time. Despite Black Friday still being a week away, the store has slashed £16.14 off the standard Xbox version of Grand Theft Auto VI, bringing its usual £69.99 price down to £53.85 at ShopTo . That's 23% off for a direct digital code, with instant delivery, and no additional vouchers or memberships needed. Better still, there are a few other ways to save on Rockstar's latest blockbuster, depending on whether you're playing on Xbox or PS5, or fancy getting some bonus content with your purchase via the Ultimate Edition As for PS5 players, ShopTo's cheapest route is a little different, since getting digital game keys for PlayStation games outside of boxed codes and PlayStation itself is a lot trickier compared to Xbox titles. Instead of receiving GTA 6 itself, ShopTo can sell you a £70 PlayStation Store gift card for only £60.85 , which you can then redeem on your UK PSN account to buy the £69.99 Standard Edition — effectively earning you £9.15 in savings. On the other hand, for anyone who wants the closest thing to a physical version of GTA 6, both consoles have a £61.85 boxed option with an added A3 double-sided poster ; that also makes ShopTo the cheapest UK retailer to buy the boxed version of Grand Theft Auto VI from right now. Remember, though, these aren't actual disc versions of GTA 6; you'll find a download code inside the packaging instead. Also, for Xbox fans who were considering buying the Grand Theft Auto 6’s Ultimate Edition anyway, ShopTo also has said Ultimate Edition on Xbox for only £67.85 — an incredibly impressive £22.14 price drop and the lowest price we’ve seen for it yet. With the Ultimate Edition, compared to the Standard Edition of GTA VI, you’ll get extra vehicles, weapons, outfits, customisation features, and exclusive locations throughout Leonida. To get that aforementioned Ultimate Edition on PS5, however, you can also grab the £100 PlayStation Store Gift Card for only £85.85 to redeem the complete version of GTA 6 for £89.99. Sure, you’ll only save £41.14 instead of buying the game through the PS Store directly, but you’ll have an extra £10 credit to spend on other games and DLC on top. Otherwise, if you’re unsure about getting the Ultimate Edition on PlayStation 5 right away, you can always buy the £20 Ultimate Edition Upgrade directly from the PlayStation Store . The same goes for the bonus Grand Theft Auto VI Vintage Vice City Pack for £4.49 — featuring the stunning ’55 Vapid Stanier sedan and garage alongside Ocean Beach, alternative outfits and hairstyles for both Jason and Lucia, and an exclusive Tropical Weapon Pattern inspired by Tommy Vercetti's iconic palm-tree shirt. At the time of writing, there is no physical disc version of GTA 6, along with there being no indication by Rockstar Games as to whether it will be putting out a disc'd edition of the game; with that, these deals are some of the best value you can get on the Grand Theft Auto sequel in the meantime. Ben Williams – IGN freelance contributor with over 10 years of experience covering gaming, tech, film, TV, and anime. Follow him on Twitter/X @BenLevelTen .

sources.title: The Normal Person’s Guide To Understanding Grand Theft Auto 6
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 is everywhere you look. Every news channel is talking about it. Celebrities and musicians are playing GTA 6 or posting about its release. It’s apparently the biggest game ever and has sold nearly 40 million copies already . But if you aren’t a big gamer or not a video game fan at all, you might have questions. I have answers. Perhaps someone sent you this link because you kept asking them GTA 6 questions. Maybe you did a Google search, made it past the AI results and found this blog explaining what GTA 6 is to people who don’t buy or play games. Whatever the case, welcome. I’m going to walk you through what is almost certainly the biggest video game launch of the decade , why people are going so wild, and what the game actually is and isn’t. It is an open-world game that mixes together a lot of video game genres, like driving, shooting, and exploration. As with most open-world games, you can run around freely or do story missions. It’s up to the player. You control two characters, Jason and Lucia, who are criminals on the run in fictional versions of Florida and Miami named Leonida and Vice City, respectively. More or less, yeah. The developer, Rockstar Games, has been working on this game since at least 2015 or so. Turns out creating a photorealistic recreation of a chunk of Florida that players can explore and do whatever they want in takes time! No. You can buy it on either PS5 or Xbox for $80. The $100 version comes with a bunch of extra outfits , hairstyles, and other items players can wear or buy in-game using cash they collect from crimes, but it’s definitely not required. It took me about 90 hours to reach the end of the main story. I’ve since played over 150 hours, and I’m still finding new stuff, hearing new songs, and seeing new random events. Yeah, it’s big. Well, a lot of people have been waiting for 13 years to play GTA 6 . The last new GTA game, GTA V , was released back in 2013. So anticipation for this game has been building for a long time. And, surprisingly, GTA 6 lived up to the hype. There are a few reasons for the glowing critical reception. The game’s narrative is really good, featuring two extremely well-written characters that develop a meaningful relationship over the course of its five chapters. Another big reason for the high review scores is just how expansive and reactive the world is. Characters in the game will comment on your clothes, respond to your actions, and remember things you did hours and hours ago. It’s also a lot of fun to play, with challenging but rewarding driving, combat, and police encounters. And it looks incredible, with some of the best graphics ever seen in a console game. Some critics are calling it the best game of the year. And many players are calling it one of the best games ever. GTA: Vice City on the PS2 was much, much smaller and less advanced (though in some ways it was pretty advanced for the time) and was set in the 1980s. While Vice City is a major location in GTA 6 , this is an unconnected and different version of the city from that seen in the original 2002 PS2 game. So many things! Players can steal cars, drive boats, get into fist fights, shoot at the cops, go fishing, play mini-golf, hit the gun range, pet dogs, scuba dive, fly planes, explore the swamps, hunt deer, join in street races, visit the beach, get drunk, buy clothes, play fake video games inside the game, take a shower, eat food, work out, blow up cars, or just chill in a bar. You can also just play through the game’s main story, which is all about Jason and Lucia trying to make some money as criminals to build a life for themselves and their son. Yes, Jason and Lucia have a child, a fact which was omitted from any pre-release marketing but is revealed in the first 20 minutes of the game. During the events of the game, he is living with his aunt while Lucia and Jason do whatever they can to make a good life for him and get him back. She is an attractive but disturbing character players meet very early in the game who may or may not be a serial killer or creepy stalker. Despite this, many people online still want to have sex with her. Some players also think Jason should hook up with Mandy and ditch Lucia. These people are wrong. No. While you can do that stuff, GTA 6 doesn’t force you to be a good boyfriend. You can be a real jerk to Lucia, and she can be a real asshole to Jason. Also, the chores players are talking about only make up a few minutes of the opening hours of GTA 6. The rest of the game has none of that stuff in it. Like the chores mentioned already, these elements are optional. If you constantly skip working out, your characters will eventually become less ripped and might even develop small bellies and thicker thighs. But you can still play all the missions and shoot cops. What? You can totally shoot random people, cops, and more. That’s not accurate. You can shoot, punch, tackle, burn, run over, drown, choke, and slap women. Uhh, you can steal cars. Some cars, like very fancy cars, have special security measures, so you can’t steal them as easily, but you can walk up to any person driving a car at a stoplight, rip them out and take their ride. Okay, so, something you need to understand about GTA 6 is that it is at the center of a massive online culture war. Conservative players, grifters, chuds, and other weirdos are currently spreading false information about this game online. There are also plenty of people online posting inflammatory nonsense to get clicks and engagement on sites like Twitter that reward that shit. So if you read something kind of wild about this game, just know it might be false. Check places like Kotaku or other major gaming sites to verify. Well, actually, Rockstar did remove sex workers you can pay to have sex with from GTA 6 . But there are still strippers in the game. Yes, GTA V has GTA Online , a very popular, successful, and still-ongoing multiplayer game with millions of players. This time around

sources.title: Mario Kart World 1.9.0 Adds Replays and New Course Picks
sources.text: Mario Kart World just received a new update. Version 1.9.0, released November 24, 2026, adds Replay, two Knockout Tour rallies, new course choices and many fixes. The latest Mario Kart was the launch title for the Nintendo Switch 2 in 2025. Many feel that the title hasn’t had key updates since its release. However, Nintendo released an update late on the night of November 24 that continues to drip-feed new content into the title. Mario Kart World version 1.9.0 adds a Replay function that saves your races and battles. It also adds Feather Rally and Lucky Cat Rally to the Knockout Tour, and new course options. Another major addition is online Free Roam missions, improved spectating, and a host of other bug fixes. The eight new courses being added are versions of classic tracks. For example, DK Pass 2 has players drive in the opposite direction of the iconic Mario Kart DS course. The update is free, but it doesn’t include new characters. Check out full patch notes from Nintendo below: What are your thoughts on this update coming to the Mario Kart World, and who are you hoping to see added as part of DLC when there are even larger content updates to the game? sources.title: PlayStation fecha parceria com CD Projekt Red para The Witcher 4
sources.text: A CD Projekt Red anunciou uma nova parceria comercial com a Sony Interactive Entertainment que envolve a campanha de marketing de The Witcher 4 e a distribuição de jogos do estúdio no ecossistema PlayStation . O anúncio foi realizado nesta terça-feira (24), durante a apresentação dos resultados financeiros do terceiro trimestre de 2026 da desenvolvedora polonesa. Segundo Piotr Nielubowicz, diretor financeiro da CD Projekt Red, os acordos foram assinados no mesmo dia e devem contribuir para os resultados comerciais e financeiros da companhia nos próximos anos. Apesar da parceria, o acordo não estabelece exclusividade para The Witcher 4. O RPG continua em desenvolvimento para PlayStation 5 , Xbox Series X|S e PC. A colaboração envolve principalmente a futura campanha publicitária do título, seguindo um modelo semelhante ao adotado pela Sony em sua parceria de marketing com a Rockstar Games para o lançamento de GTA 6. O contrato também contempla a presença de jogos da CD Projekt Red no catálogo do PlayStation Plus . Entretanto, as empresas não divulgaram quais títulos serão disponibilizados no serviço de assinatura. Os valores financeiros e demais condições comerciais do acordo também não foram revelados. De acordo com informações do Video Games Chronicle (VGC), The Witcher 4 segue com previsão de lançamento para 2028. Atualmente, quase metade da equipe de desenvolvimento da CD Projekt Red está dedicada ao projeto. O RPG marcará o início de uma nova trilogia da franquia. Segundo os planos apresentados anteriormente pelo estúdio, a intenção é lançar os três jogos dentro de um intervalo de seis anos. A estratégia representa uma aposta da desenvolvedora na continuidade da franquia e na redução do intervalo entre seus grandes lançamentos. Por enquanto, The Witcher 4 ainda não possui uma data oficial de estreia. Rachele Victoria é formada em Letras, MBA em Inovação e atua há 10 anos com comunicação e conteúdo gamer. A atualização tem como principal objetivo oferecer aos jogadores mais liberdade para personalizar suas experiências no endgame, etapa posterior à campanha principal. Entre as novidades estão mudanças nos Planos de Guerra, uma nova árvore de progressão sazonal, equipamentos inéditos e novos confrontos contra chefes. A temporada também apresenta uma série de missões protagonizadas por Tyrael, que investiga as verdadeiras intenções do culto da morte e uma nova ameaça a Santuário. A Temporada do Gambito de Tyrael introduz seis principais novidades: Além dos conteúdos inéditos, a Blizzard confirmou que recursos populares da Temporada do Legado Infernal serão incorporados permanentemente aos reinos de Temporada e Eternos. Com as mudanças, a Blizzard busca ampliar a variedade de atividades disponíveis no endgame e oferecer mais autonomia para que os jogadores desenvolvam seus personagens de acordo com seus objetivos. A Temporada do Gambito de Tyrael estará disponível a partir de 1º de dezembro. Rachele Victoria é formada em Letras, MBA em Inovação e atua há 10 anos com comunicação e conteúdo gamer. Amazon Prime também é feito para jogadores! Todo mês, obtenha itens exclusivos, jogos grátis, uma assinatura gratuita na Twitch.tv e muito mais com sua assinatura Prime . sources.title: Até quanto pagar na Black Friday 2026?
sources.text: A Black Friday é uma das melhores oportunidades de compras do ano, mas nem todo desconto anunciado representa uma economia real. Para aproveitar a data, é importante saber quanto cada produto já custou e qual valor pode ser considerado uma boa oferta . Consultar o menor preço histórico antes de comprar ajuda a evitar falsas promoções e permite fazer escolhas mais inteligentes. Neste guia, o TecMundo traz algumas referências de preços para produtos populares , de celulares e notebooks a eletrodomésticos, para ajudar você a aproveitar melhor os descontos desse período. As buscas por tecnologia, celulares, televisores, eletrodomésticos e produtos para casa costumam ganhar força na Black Friday, especialmente entre consumidores que planejam compras de maior valor. Por isso, saber até que valor é vantajoso pagar no aparelho novo ajuda muito a fazer um bom negócio na hora de fechar a compra. Confira também Confira os cupons de Black Friday para resgatar já! Confira os cupons de Black Friday para resgatar já! Usamos ferramentas que monitoram buscas na internet, como Semrush e Google Trends, e agentes de inteligência artificial para montar um guia prático. A lista tem produtos com maior volume de buscas e a média de preços nos últimos 12 meses. O PlayStation 5 é um dos produtos mais desejados por quem quer aproveitar a Black Friday para investir em entretenimento. Para o PS5 Slim Digital, vale buscar ofertas próximas de R$ 2.500, enquanto a versão com leitor de discos pode ser interessante na faixa de R$ 2.800. Lembrando que o leitor também pode ser adquirido separadamente para modelos Slim. Já o PS5 Pro , que oferece desempenho gráfico aprimorado, merece atenção quando estiver em torno de R$ 5.000. Um notebook com configurações intermediárias pode atender muito bem às tarefas de trabalho, estudo, navegação e entretenimento, sem exigir um investimento elevado na Black Friday deste ano. O Dell Inspiron 15 com Intel Core i5, SSD de 512 GB, 8 GB de RAM e Windows 11 é uma opção versátil para a rotina. Se aparecer próximo a R$ 3.000 na promoção deste ano, vale a compra. O Acer Aspire 5 com i5, 512 GB SSD, 8 GB de RAM e Windows 11 é uma alternativa ao modelo da Dell e pode ser uma boa compra se for encontrado por volta de R$2.800. Televisores também estão em alta nas buscas relacionadas à maior data promocional do ano. Os modelos da Samsung e da LG são os mais almejados. A Samsung QN70H de 55 polegadas, com tecnologia Mini LED, é uma opção interessante para quem busca qualidade de imagem. Se aparecer esse modelo por algo em torno de R$ 3.400, pode crer que é uma boa oportunidade. A LG QNED70 de 55 polegadas oferece resolução 4K e recursos inteligentes, e é um bom investimento se encontrada por valores próximos de R$ 2.200 com os descontos de Black Friday. A busca por smartphones premium na Black Friday aumenta. A linha Galaxy S e o modelo mais recente do iPhone são sempre mais visados, mas é preciso saber os valores que tem sido cobrados por eles para fazer um investimento inteligente. Com opções para diferentes perfis, a linha iPhone 17 tem desde modelos mais acessíveis até versões Pro voltadas para desempenho e fotografia. Preste bastante atenção aos preços para não acabar confundindo as alternativas disponíveis. A família Galaxy S25 oferece diferentes combinações de desempenho, câmeras e recursos de inteligência artificial. Buscar ofertas realmente sabendo os preços máximos ideais ajuda bastante no processo de compra. Os tablets também são muito desejados em datas promocionais. Se você está em busca de um modelo para estudar, trabalhar ou para entretenimento, temos algumas sugestões. Mesmo sendo de duas gerações anteriores, a linha Galaxy Tab S10 segue relevante e reúne tablets para diferentes necessidades. Analise bem os recursos e especificações de cada opção para ver qual combina melhor com o seu perfil antes de fechar a compra na BF deste ano. O iPad 11” com chip A16 é uma opção para quem busca bom desempenho em produtividade, navegação e entretenimento, sendo especialmente indicado para os usuários e fãs do ecossistema Apple. Na categoria eletrodomésticos a geladeira é o mais desejado, e não é à toa. Investir em um eletro caro como este na Black Friday ajuda a reduzir bastante o investimento. Com capacidade próxima de 480 litros, a Electrolux TF7 1 é indicada para famílias que precisam de espaço e praticidade, podendo ser uma ótima aquisição com desconto na BF. A Brastemp BRM45JK combina capacidade de 375 litros e praticidade para o dia a dia. Se aparecer nessa faixa, pode representar uma boa oportunidade de investimento. Outro eletro muito desejado nesta época de calor é o ar-condicionado. Aqui, além dos valores, é importante conferir o consumo de energia e outras especificações. O Gree G-Side de 12.000 BTUs é uma alternativa interessante para quem busca boa climatização a preço justo e ainda quer economizar com os descontos da promoção. O modelo LG de 9.000 BTUs pode atender ambientes menores, sendo recomendado para quartos ou salas pequenas. Praticidade na cozinha também fica em alta na Black Friday, e o micro-ondas está entre os itens mais buscados, principalmente modelos compactos. O Electrolux ME23B conta com recursos de descongelamento e funções práticas para o uso cotidiano, sendo uma compra interessante se for encontrado na casa dos R$ 480. Se disponível por cerca de R$ 480, o modelo inox Brastemp de 20 litros com funções de pré-preparo, que podem agilizar tarefas na cozinha, é uma alternativa interessante que não pesa no bolso. Além de praticidade, a air fryer oferece uma alimentação mais saudável, por isso se tornou o eletroportátil com mais procura em datas promocionais. Se estiver nessa faixa, a Mondial Family de 4 litros é uma boa escolha para preparar porções de alimentos com praticidade em um modelo que cabe no orçamento. A WAP Barbecue Digital reúne recursos que ampliam as possibilidades de preparo de carnes suculentas em um churrasco, ainda mais se estiver nesta faixa de preç

sources.title: Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair is getting a Switch 2 Definitive Edition
sources.text: Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair will boast better visuals and 120FPS on Switch 2 Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition has been announced for Nintendo Switch 2. Available from next month, on December 15, Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair : Definitive Edition will offer improved performance and visuals and come packaged with the Trowzer’s Top Tonic Pack DLC. This follows the launch of Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair on the original Switch , PS4 , Xbox One , and PC in 2019. If you had the original game on Switch, this Definitive Edition upgrade is available for free. You will just need a physical copy of the game, or use the same Nintendo account you used to purchase a digital copy on Switch. We’re still waiting on the specifics, but we’re told that the Definitive Edition will support up to 120FPS, and “enhanced lighting and ambient occlusion effects.”, and “higher-fidelity textures and shadows”. Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair was met with positive reviews back at launch . Unlike the first game in the series, The Impossible Lair opts for 2D platforming, more akin to Donkey Kong Country than its initial Banjo-Kazooie inspirations. The efforts paid off, with the game being much better received by both critics and fans, and keeping the series going for further releases. Following on from Impossible Lair, developer Playtonic released a remake of the first game, Yooka-Replaylee, in 2025. Alongside the re-release of Impossible Lair, Playtonic is also working on the first Yooka-Laylee racer, Super Yooka-Laylee Kart, which doesn’t currently have a release date.

sources.name: Gematsu
sources.title: Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition announced for PS5, Switch 2, and PC
sources.text: Playtonic Games has announced Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition , an enhanced re-release of the 2019-released side-scrolling platformer. It will launch for PlayStation 5 , Switch 2 , and PC via Steam on December 15 as a free upgrade for existing owners. Here is an overview of the game, via Playtonic Games: One of the best platforming adventures of its generation is back, enhanced for PlayStation 5, Switch 2, and PC. Yooka and Laylee return for a full-scale 2.5D adventure, with a 3D Overworld that’s an adventure in its own right, levels you can alter to create new ways to play, and Capital B’s Impossible Lair waiting to test your skills. Explore vibrant worlds packed with enemies, secrets, and collectables. Complete objectives, uncover hidden paths, meet a colorful cast of characters, and rescue the Royal Beettalion as you prepare for Yooka and Laylee’s biggest test yet. Optimized for PlayStation 5, Switch 2, and PC Enjoy sharper visuals, smoother performance, enhanced visual effects, and more! All the bees in the Royal Beettallion have been bee-napped! Every level beaten is a bee rescued (and one more hit you can survive in the Impossible Lair itself!). Do you beat every course to rebuild the Beettallion or take on the Impossible Lair early to see how you fare? Run, jump, roll, and dodge your way through the many levels, then take them on again in radically altered forms! Dash through turret-filled towns, spider-infested forests, trap-happy factories, and even airships soaring amongst the clouds. Find secret T.W.I.T. Coins to bypass the nefarious Trowzer’s paywalls scattered across the Overworld and unlock new areas with more levels to discover. The more you explore the adventure-filled Overworld, the more levels you’ll find. Solve its many mysteries, open up new routes, and complete its challenges to help rescue every last member of the Royal Beettalion. Think you’ve got a level figured out? Think again. Out in the Overworld, find ways to flood levels, freeze them, or even flip them upside down to unlock alternative routes, layouts, and even crazier surprises. Discover over 60 hidden Tonics to unlock new skins, visual effects, challenges, skills, and perks. Mix and match them to create crazy play styles and OP combos! The toughest platforming challenge your skills can take on! Tackle the Impossible Lair at any time! Of course, the more levels you beat, the easier it gets. You choose how challenging you want it to be(e)! Watch the announcement trailer below. View the first screenshots at the gallery .

sources.title: Sony Confirms PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for December 2026
sources.text: Sony has confirmed the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for December, which will be available to download from Tuesday, December 1 to Monday January 4. In a PlayStation Blog post , Sony said Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, and Amnesia: The Bunker are December’s three titles. Will you be able to tear yourself away from GTA 6 to give either of these games a shot? Or perhaps you're after a palate cleanser after pumping 100 hours into Rockstar's epic? IGN's Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 review returned an 8/10. We said: "Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 proves yet again the series’ over-the-top skateboarding formula is totally timeless, even if some of the changes to THPS4 miss the mark and the soundtrack has been fumbled." Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, meanwhile, got a 7.5 back in 2017 . "Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 is an ambitious , if rough-edged experience, with deceptively deep RPG and brawling elements," we said at the time. And our Amnesia: The Bunker review returned an 8. We said: "Amnesia: The Bunker is a smaller, more self-contained episode in the groundbreaking horror franchise that shows Frictional still has some chilling new tricks up their sleeves." It’s worth noting that PlayStation Plus members have until Monday, November 30 to add the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for November (Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider IV – VI Remastered, Monster Train 2) to their library.
